# Canvas Escape

A minimalist endless‑runner where the player controls a small circle that drifts through a side‑scrolling field of rotating rectangular obstacles. Each obstacle has a gap; the player must steer through the gaps using arrow keys. The game ends (lose condition) when the circle collides with an obstacle or leaves the canvas bounds. Score increases with distance traveled. Simple shapes and animations make it perfect for HTML canvas.

1: // Canvas Escape – minimal endless‑runner
2: // Canvas element with id "game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   // ----- audio -----
6:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
7:   // resume on user interaction (click or key press)
8:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume(); };
9:   window.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio);
10:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio);
11: 
12:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.type = 'sine';
16:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
17:     osc.connect(gain);
18:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
20:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
21:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, now + 0.01);
22:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + duration / 1000);
23:     osc.start(now);
24:     osc.stop(now + duration / 1000);
25:   }
26: 
27:   function playCollision() { playTone(150, 200); }
28:   function playGameOver() { playTone(80, 500); }
29: 
30:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
31:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
32:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
33:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
34:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
35:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
36: 
37:   // ----- player -----
38:   const player = {
39:     x: width * 0.2,
40:     y: height / 2,
41:     radius: 12,
42:     speedX: 0,
43:     speedY: 0,
44:     maxSpeed: 4,
45:     update() {
46:       this.x += this.speedX;
47:       this.y += this.speedY;
48:       // keep inside bounds (lose condition if out)
49:       if (this.x < 0 || this.x > width || this.y < 0 || this.y > height) this.alive = false;
50:     },
51:     draw() {
52:       // radial gradient for glowing effect
53:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x, this.y, this.radius * 0.2, this.x, this.y, this.radius);
54:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#fffacd');
55:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#ff8800');
56:       ctx.beginPath();
57:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
58:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
59:       ctx.fill();
60:     },
61:     alive: true,
62:   };
63: 
64:   // ----- input handling -----
65:   const keys = {};
66:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
67:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
68: 
69:   function handleInput() {
70:     player.speedX = 0; player.speedY = 0;
71:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.speedY = -player.maxSpeed;
72:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.speedY = player.maxSpeed;
73:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.speedX = -player.maxSpeed;
74:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.speedX = player.maxSpeed;
75:   }
76: 
77:   // ----- obstacles -----
78:   class Obstacle {
79:     constructor() {
80:       this.x = width + 40; // start off‑screen
81:       this.y = Math.random() * height;
82:       this.width = 80; // length of bar
83:       this.height = 20; // thickness of bar
84:       this.gap = 80; // size of gap in the bar
85:       this.angle = 0; // rotation angle in radians
86:       this.speed = 2; // horizontal speed
87:       // random rotation direction
88:       this.rotSpeed = (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * (Math.PI / 180) * (1 + Math.random() * 2);
89:     }
90:     update() {
91:       this.x -= this.speed;
92:       this.angle += this.rotSpeed;
93:     }
94:     draw() {
95:       ctx.save();
96:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
97:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
98:       ctx.fillStyle = '#3498db';
99:       // draw two rectangles leaving a gap in the middle
100:       // top part
101:       ctx.fillRect(-this.width / 2, -this.height / 2 - this.gap / 2, this.width, this.height);
102:       // bottom part
103:       ctx.fillRect(-this.width / 2, this.gap / 2, this.width, this.height);
104:       ctx.restore();
105:     }
106:     // simple circle‑rectangle collision using separating axis theorem approximation
107:     collides(circle) {
108:       // approximate by checking distance from obstacle center line
109:       const dx = circle.x - this.x;
110:       const dy = circle.y - this.y;
111:       // rotate point opposite to obstacle rotation
112:       const cos = Math.cos(-this.angle);
113:       const sin = Math.sin(-this.angle);
114:       const rx = dx * cos - dy * sin;
115:       const ry = dx * sin + dy * cos;
116:       // check against two axis‑aligned rectangles
117:       const halfW = this.width / 2;
118:       const halfH = this.height / 2;
119:       const gapHalf = this.gap / 2;
120:       const inTop = ry > -halfH - circle.radius && ry < -gapHalf && rx > -halfW && rx < halfW;
121:       const inBottom = ry > gapHalf && ry < halfH + circle.radius && rx > -halfW && rx < halfW;
122:       return inTop || inBottom;
123:     }
124:     offscreen() { return this.x + this.width < 0; }
125:   }
126: 
127:   const obstacles = [];
128:   let frame = 0;
129:   let gameOverPlayed = false;
130:   let score = 0;
131: 
132:   function spawnObstacle() {
133:     obstacles.push(new Obstacle());
134:   }
135: 
136:   function update() {
137:     if (!player.alive) return;
138:     handleInput();
139:     player.update();
140:     // obstacles
141:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.update());
142:     // remove off‑screen obstacles
143:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].offscreen()) obstacles.shift();
144:     // collision
145:     for (const o of obstacles) {
146:       if (o.collides(player)) { player.alive = false; playCollision(); break; }
147:     }
148:     // score – increase per frame
149:     score++;
150:     // spawn new obstacles every 120 frames (~2 sec at 60fps)
151:     if (frame % 120 === 0) spawnObstacle();
152:     frame++;
153:   }
154: 
155: function draw() {
156:     // motion‑blur effect: draw a translucent dark rectangle over previous frame
157:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
158:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
159:     // background gradient
160:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
161:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#222');
162:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
163:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
164:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
165:     // obstacles (draw with gradient)
166:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.draw());
167:     // player
168:     if (player.alive) player.draw();
169:     // score overlay
170:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
171:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
172:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score / 60), 10, 20);
173:     if (!player.alive) {
174:       if (!gameOverPlayed) { playGameOver(); gameOverPlayed = true; }
175:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
176:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
177:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5555';
178:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
179:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
180:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
181:     }
182:   }
183:   }
184: 
185:   function loop() {
186:     update();
187:     draw();
188:     if (player.alive) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
189:   }
190: 
191:   // start
192:   spawnObstacle();
193:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
194: })();
